mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the diaphragm was most worthwhile: the planned paired views connect muscle movement, lung expansion and quiet exhalation rather than merely naming the parts.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the rib cage was fairly predictable, and its result mostly described placement rather than explaining how the intercostal muscles contribute to breathing.

surprise.text: The final explanation clarified how the pleural interface transmits chest expansion to the lungs, and that elastic recoil helps air leave during quiet breathing.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the fluid-filled pleural space was shown before its mechanical role was explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the final construction connected anatomy to a useful physiological mechanism, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than this short, largely sequential assembly offered.
